ELON Musk SHUTS DOWN THE “DOGE KILLED PEOPLE” CLAIM

In the Economist interview, the editor pushed the idea that DOGE cuts to USAID caused deaths.

Elon’s response was blunt:
“Zero.”
When pressed, he called the claims “false… nonsense and absolute nonsense.”
He explained that legitimate programs were moved to the State Department, and that when you cut funding to fraudulent or ineffective organizations, the people who lost the money never admit it was waste. They invent the most sympathetic story possible to get the funding restored.
That’s exactly what happened.
The media ran with the emotional narrative. Elon stuck to the facts.

GROK 4.5 IS DOMINATING THE EFFICIENCY FRONTIER
Grok 4.5 just posted multiple #1 results across demanding coding and agentic benchmarks:

• #1 among models under a strict cost workload
It’s also delivering dramatically better cost efficiency than Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on real coding tasks.
Grok 4.5 isn’t just competing on raw capability — it’s winning on the combination of performance + efficiency that actually matters for real work.

Tesla Owners Silicon Valley.

Yesterday at the Tesla store on Santana Row in San Jose with Tesla Owners Silicon Valley. The energy was high and families were genuinely excited checking out the Model Y L and Cybercab displays.

The Model Y L was definitely the main conversation of the day — the extra space and redesign had people talking nonstop. It was cool seeing kids and parents light up while exploring everything.

Moments like this remind me why community events matter. Real people, real reactions, and a look at what’s next. Grateful to be there documenting it.
